change: Replace pitched hit and damage pulses with original, deterministic body, headshot and damage impact samples
baseline: Confirmed body and headshot feedback used short sine pulses; damage taken used a low triangle pulse.

checks.browser: Native practice started ARC-9, NEEDLE, ION-5, RAIL-LANCE and SCATTER samples; injected confirmed feedback started all three impact samples without page errors.
checks.browserEngine: Playwright Chromium headless shell 1234 on Apple M4 Max

limits: The impact event test injects presentation feedback; it does not claim a human landed three different hits in a native match.
Blind listening, physical speakers or headphones, and real-device performance remain unmeasured.
The PCM estimate counts sample data only, not Web Audio implementation overhead.
